properties.notes: Former concrete plant that is no longer in use and is now vacant following closure. This site is adjacent to further employment land, much of which is occupied, and also recently completed residential development. The former industrial buildings and apparatus have recently been cleared. Any residential scheme would have to carefully consider the relationship with surrounding uses as well as overcoming any access limitations. The site could represent an opportunity for redevelopment if no longer required for industrial use, potentially in conjunction with adjacent land from the SHLAA (6479, 4734, 6783).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
